name: smwmusic-super-mario-maker-2-smw-forest-early
title: Super Mario Maker 2 - SMW Forest (Early Version)
description:
This is the new SMW forest theme introduced in SMM2, based on the SNES version made by Mathew Valente ("Early version" refers to the fact that the full song hasn't been released yet). It mostly uses SMW samples.

Obviously fit for forest areas.
